title: research/lockstep-live-role-audit: live roles in the lockstep compiler and the #4470 outer constant C (no new κ)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark**_

## Change and mathematical scope

**Audit with a positive scoped result; no new κ.** The selected κ is unchanged.

Before: DELAYED-COVER-BRIDGE open question 1 was open. It asks whether the lockstep compiler gives every simultaneously live child role a distinct physical array, which both the delayed BIT cover and the row-digit reserve assume. The outer-reserve constant `C` for #4470 was only illustrative (#4612).

After: `research/lockstep-live-role-audit` answers both questions.

- **Live roles.** This is an independent implementation of the FINITE-PRECOMPILATION compiler: the Theorem 1G lockstep flow, `a` replicas, source complements, and exit substitution by the smaller uniform program. It is **executed event by event**, with a stack of live roles on every array. A push is a whole-fiber cover route and a pop is its inverse. At every event it checks:
  - the units of a class lie on distinct arrays;
  - child roles are nested whole jobs on the array the suspended parent issued;
  - a unit issues only on an array it currently owns, and only after its previous child has finished;
  - every route is undone LIFO;
  - exit and complement batches receive distinct, owned arrays;
  - every array gets exactly one complement and one source job.

  All checks pass on the toy rule (full width up to rank 40, 6.9M events), on BIT-shaped rules (targets {8,22,50}, paid 1..7, random and adversarial owners, up to rank 25600 and three generations) and on the actual complex p2 rule with its native owners. Counting reproduces the FINITE-DAG-AUDIT receipts (91,854/2,242,264 and 1397/57,149). The README gives the general induction.
- **Constant C.** For the #4470 templates (BIT ranks from #4440, complex word `N_c = 2^64215200000000`), `log2 C <= 64,215,200,000,088`. The complex row stock dominates. `H(p)` fits `p^β` from `log2 p = 64,473,100,659,114` (#4612's illustrative value was 5.2e13). It also dominates the #4618 term.

Remaining obligations:
- Two inherited coefficients of `C` (`c_row`, `A_old <= 2^64`).
- The 1024-fold #4470 owner chronology is not materialized. It is represented by BIT-shaped rules of the same structure.

## Task and overlap

- **Card.** `selected-stock-envelope`, priority revision 7. Scope **refined** to the two open questions of #4612.
- **Base.** `b58ad9ef4`. Eleven inputs are pinned in SOURCES.json.
- **Overlap.**
  - #4612 is the parent audit. This package is independent of its files.
  - `transfer-audit/finite_dag_audit.py` checks only class-local field distinctness and batch counts. This package adds event-level execution across classes, replicas, complements and exits, plus BIT-shaped rules.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/lockstep-live-role-audit
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/lockstep-live-role-audit
```

Both pass (CPython 3.12, Windows, standard library only; verify.py takes about 4 minutes).

Rejecting controls:
- one owned center per recursion depth instead of one per unit instance (the allocation FINITE-PRECOMPILATION §6 calls insufficient);
- an eager parent that issues round j+1 before child class j finishes;
- an exit batch that repeats an array.

These are finite executions. At astronomical widths (up to about 10^254), two replicas are executed and the smaller programs are checked through their interface.
